chunks.title: Kit MRP Enhancement
chunks.heading: Solution › Kit MRP Enhancement
chunks.text:
We have two Styles, Style 1 and Style 2. Now based on these styles we make KIT & Packs.

Kit consists of Two Styles Style 1 – Flannel Pants & Style 2 – Flannel LS Shirt
Pack1 Consists of Two or More Same styles – Style 1& 2 – Flannel Pants
Pack2 Consists of Two or More Same styles – Style 1& 2 – Flannel Pants

chunks.title: Pending MRP List for KIT
chunks.heading: Solution › MRP › Pending MRP List for KIT
chunks.text:
After Pending MRP List of Pack Sales Order then there is an enhancement in the screen there will be two Tabs on the screen First Tab is KIT and Second Tab is for Style.

Now 1st Tab – KIT/Pack: Here in this Tab, it will show KIT/Pack at Level -1 with columns names as given below. Based on the actions taken in KIT/Pack on the Level -1 it will generate Requirement for 2nd Tab.
Now 2nd Tab – Style: Here in this Tab, it will show Styles at level 1(Style 1 – Flannel Pants & Style 2 – Flannel LS Shirt) & Raw Material at Level 2.
chunks.locator: § Solution › MRP › Pending MRP List for KIT
